entities.summary: Eugen Philippovich Freiherr von Philippsberg was an Austrian economist, stemming from the Croatian noble family Philippovich von Philippsberg. His textbook Grundriss der politischen Oekonomie was "the most successful German-language textbook on economics" of its time: the first volume went through 19 editions, selling over 63,000 copies.
